column3: NASB supplies “took action” for the Hebrew “and he took,” which has no object; the meaning is uncertain.
“chosen in the assembly” renders “called of the appointed meeting,” and “men of renown” renders “men of name.”
“You have gone far enough” renders “enough for you (rav lakhem)” (also in verse 7).
“is it not enough for you” renders “is it too little for you” (also in verse 13), and NASB supplies “the rest of.”
“lord it over us” renders an emphatic doubled verb, “make yourself ruler, ruler.”
“Moses became very angry” renders “it burned to Moses exceedingly.”
“firepan” and “censer” render the same word, mahtah.
“the dwellings” renders the singular “the dwelling (mishkan)” (also in verse 27).
“this is not my doing” renders “not from my own heart.”
“suffer the fate of all men” renders “the visitation of all men is visited on them.”
“brings about an entirely new thing” renders “creates a creation (beri’ah).”
